### Kindness & Treachery: The Gospel in 2 Chronicles
Author: Melissa Kruger
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/melissa-kruger/kindness-treachery-the-gospel-in-2-chronicles-2/
Passage: 2 Chronicles 22:11-12
Points:
- Jehoshabeath acted courageously to rescue baby Joash and hide him in the temple during Athaliah's murderous purge.
- Later in life, Joash repaid this life-saving kindness with betrayal by having Jehoshabeath's son Zechariah executed.
- Rather than identifying with the heroic rescuer, believers should recognize themselves in the unfaithful, rescued Joash.
- The gospel reveals that God continually pursues and rescues undeserving sinners who have rejected Him.
- Unlike Jehoshabeath, God knowingly chose to save us at the deliberate cost of His own Son's life.
